skills.name: Fractions & decimals in equations
skills.wrong_turn: Multiply every term: x/3 + 1/2 = 5/6 times 6 is 2x + 3 = 5, not 2x + 1/2 = 5.
skills.rule: Multiply every term by the LCD, or by a power of 10, to clear fractions and decimals.

skills.name: Literal equations

steps.a: solve a formula for one letter

skills.wrong_turn: Divide the whole side: P = 2l + 2w gives w = (P − 2l)/2, not P − 2l/2.
skills.rule: To solve for one letter, treat every other letter as a number.

skills.name: Absolute value equations
skills.wrong_turn: Isolate first: 2|x| + 3 = 11 means |x| = 4, so x = ±4. Don't split 2x + 3 = ±11.
skills.rule: |A|=c with c≥0 means A=c or A=−c.

skills.name: Compound inequalities
skills.wrong_turn: "x < 1 or x > 4" can't be squeezed into 4 < x < 1. That form means "and", and here it is empty.
skills.rule: "And" is the overlap, ∩. "Or" is the union, ∪.

skills.name: Absolute value inequalities
skills.wrong_turn: |x| > 3 is not −3 > x > 3, which no number satisfies. Write x < −3 or x > 3.
